episode.showDescription: The official podcast of comedian Joe Rogan.
episode.episodeDescription: Jimmy Donaldson, better known as MrBeast, is a YouTuber, entrepreneur, and philanthropist. He is the founder of Beast Industries and Beast Philanthropy, and the creator and host of the Prime Video competition series “Beast Games.”www.beastgames.comwww.beastphilanthropy.orgwww.youtube.com/@MrBeast Learn more about your ad choices. Visit podcastchoices.com/adchoices

quoted or archival commercials used as editorial evidence

transcript_window.text: And so I think it – and I was really the first person to kind of adopt that mindset, and more people are doing it now.
But, yeah, that's why I go and share everything, like, literally to a T.
And I'll help people make – some people end up making millions of dollars that I've helped mentored.
And I'm just like, yeah, it's just fun.
Because they always ask me, like, why are you doing it?
And I think the internet encourages that, fortunately.
Because television is the opposite of that.
So television, the problem was there was only a certain amount of slots.
Beast show was on NBC and then there was another guy who was on CBS, he might also be at 8 p .m.
But because the fact that YouTube is available literally to anybody and the amount of people that are viewing it is so immense, it's an abundance and you treat it like that.
And it actually just makes you grow.
It's also, if you share with people, they'll share with you.
